title: Add rocket feature to Commander help output
description: Ensure the 'feature' subcommand appears in 'rocket --help' with a correct description. Add usage examples to the feature command's own help text.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket --help lists 'feature' with description 'Generate a feature spec and tasks from a natural language description'
rocket feature --help shows all three flags (--no-questions, --dry-run, --backend)

steps.details: Run `npm run dev -- --help`. Confirm 'feature' is listed with its description. If not, check the Commander registration in src/cli.ts.

steps.description: Add usage examples to feature command
steps.details:
In Commander, add .addHelpText('after', '
Examples:
  rocket feature "Add dark mode toggle"
  rocket feature --no-questions "Add email notifications"
  rocket feature --dry-run "Add user profiles"')
